code:
using KernelAbstractions

function axpby_kernel!(y, x, a, b)
    @kernel begin
        y[i] = a * x[i] + b * y[i]
    end
end

function solve!(y, x, a, b)
    if length(y) == 0
        return y
    end
    backend = get_backend(y)
    ndrange = length(y)
    workgroup_size = 64
    axpby_kernel!(y, x, a, b; ndrange=ndrange, workgroup_size=workgroup_size)
    synchronize(backend)
    return y
end
